_help: Nova players listed here show their cosmetics to everyone using Nova, and get the Nova star next to their name. Use their Minecraft name. Slots: cape (nova, galaxy, aurora, rainbow, lava, flame, matrix, neon, storm, void, sunset, ice, crimson, midnight, ocean, forest, sakura, gold, checker, candy), wings (angel, phoenix, dragon, demon, bat, crystal, fairy, butterfly), head (halo, rainbow_halo, crown, horns, cat_ears, bunny_ears, top_hat, flower_crown), aura (stars, rainbow_stars, hearts, embers, snow, atom). Example: "SomePlayer": {"cape": "galaxy", "wings": "angel"}
